does: Evaluates a spell's SpellRoll condition for one target, applying the cast's spell modifications to the condition string first when there are any for this spell; every spell's attack roll and spell save, and a creature's weapon attack, passes it. Arguments: RCX the spell's condition, RDX the ls::thoth::shared::ContextData (caster +0x0, target +0x10), R8 a pointer to the spell's FixedString (the first 4 bytes of a SpellId), R9 the cast's spell-modification container (may be null), then the stats and the condition machine on the stack.

evidence.says: calls eoc::GetSpellConditionString and eoc::spell::ModifySpellRoll::Apply, then evaluates through 0xF00090 or 0xFD9FD0
one call per Sacred Flame cast, from +0x3726D47; the caller chains of Sacred Flame's save, Hold Person's save and a goblin's weapon attack pass it at +0xFCE3CF

hashes the FixedString R8 points to and looks it up in the container R9 points to (its +0x30 holds the modifications per spell); calls eoc::GetSpellConditionString with RCX and eoc::spell::ModifySpellRoll::Apply, then evaluates with RDX as the context through unplaced::EvaluateConditionList

at the moment of the roll R8 points at Target_SacredFlame's FixedString (0x4DC000B0) for Sacred Flame, Projectile_FireBolt's (0x4E4000B0) for Fire Bolt and Target_MainHandAttack's (0x20300011) for a goblin's weapon attack (each compared with GetPropertyAddress of the SpellBook entry's Prototype); RDX is the same address that unplaced::EvaluateStatsCondition receives in R9 next

the argument list fits eoc::spell::CheckModifiableSpellRollCondition(Condition const&, ContextData&, FixedString const&, ModificationContainerComponent const*, RPGStats const&, Machine&) of the builds with symbols

questions.ask: Rename to eoc::spell::CheckModifiableSpellRollCondition once its callees are compared with that build.
